title: A-A pair at rest, separation 5 to 9: piecewise-linear K(r) table at P = 2.5, narrows and supersedes P-0027

claims.statement: Two A particles at rest, initial separation r0 in [5.0, 9.0]: each accelerates toward the other with magnitude K(r) / r^2.5, r the current separation, where K(r) is linear between the nodes K = 17.834 (r = 5), 16.617 (6), 15.121 (7), 13.432 (8), 11.624 (9). Measured positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.007 of the chamber side for durations up to 2.0 when r0 < 7 and 3.0 when r0 >= 7. The claim is for A-A only, two particles, at rest, at exponent 2.5 with this table. It makes no claim for initial separations in [3, 5) (the P-0027 nodes 3 and 4 and the K(r) values there are withdrawn; replicates r3/003-004 gave K about 2.7% above the table at 3.5 and 4.5), for r < 3 or r > 9, other species, other exponents or shapes, or three or more particles.
